scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: mise trust && mise install && (cd backend && mise exec -- pnpm install) && (cd web && mise exec -- pnpm install)

scripts.name: Run Backend
scripts.command: cd backend && mise exec -- pnpm install && mise exec -- pnpm dev

scripts.name: Run Web
scripts.command: cd web && mise exec -- pnpm install && mise exec -- pnpm dev

scripts.name: Game Tests
scripts.command: cd mod && mise exec -- ./gradlew runClientGameTest runProdClientGameTest
